h1: Do I need a permit for a screened porch or three-season sunroom in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Screened Porch and Sunroom Permits: Foundations and Setbacks
description: Learn why a new porch or sunroom needs building and zoning review and which design details must be confirmed.
short_answer: A new screened porch or sunroom is a building project that should be reviewed by Newton ISD before construction. The structure must also meet the property's zoning standards for setbacks, height, and lot coverage. The exact foundation, frost-depth, and enclosure requirements depend on the design and applicable code.

facts.text: The state building code requires a permit before regulated construction of a building or structure.
Newton Engineering reviews certain site plans involving additions, grading, impervious-area changes, and other site work.

qa.q: Is a screened porch treated the same as an open patio?
qa.a: Do not assume so. A porch or sunroom is a structure, and the building and zoning requirements depend on its foundation, enclosure, location, and design.
